notes.title: Core fixes and updates
notes.content:
It's been a while... But here are some core fixes and updates to help you answer questions and kill zombies!

[list]
[*] Fixed issue with uncapped framerate.
[*] Added menu options for audio controls.
[*] Fixed issues with question boxes disappearing under certain circumstances.
[*] Small tweaks and changes to timings, audio and visuals.
[/list]
